verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents its own APIs for building custom verification workflows and says screening runs through one API, so programmatic operation of the pipeline exists in some form. The evidence does not show the specific operations or how agents authenticate. Team roles (docs-18) cover human dashboard users, not API credential scoping, and ongoing re-screening is automated monitoring rather than an agent-triggered re-check, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented session-creation, outcome-polling and extracted-data retrieval endpoints, an API-triggered re-check operation, scoped API credentials, an MCP surface, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate the verification pipeline — create sessions, poll outcomes, retrieve extracted data, and trigger re-checks through the API or an MCP surface with scoped credentials

citations.quote: Build fully custom verification workflows using AiPrise APIs for maximum control and flexibility.
Screen adverse media, PEPs, sanctions, and watchlists in real time - all through one API.
